integrity: Finite exact Gaussian-integer autocorrelation checks for dimensions 4 through 7 at seven parameters per dimension; separately implemented direct complex projector Gram checks in dimension 4; universal claim rests on a proof via finite-abelian Weyl diagonalization and exact shell intersection classification.
scientific_limitations: Only Boolean groups and windows with weight-two shell and arbitrary complex apex coefficient.
The numerical projector-Gram spectrum comparison has floating tolerance; the underlying ambiguity verifications are exact integer computations.
No nonlinear phase retrieval, noise-stability, or large-shell extensions are claimed.
The known generic Gabor eigenvalue formula is explicitly credited; priority for this evaluated family cannot be guaranteed from bounded comparison.
Independent mathematical audit and validation have not been performed.
title: Apex-weighted Hamming two-shells: an exact Gabor rank discriminant and a universal two-atom spectral law
